defs.def: a chemical element. Iron is a hard strong metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food. 铁

ex.s: The original iron boxes with the round roofs first appeared in 1926.
ex.t: 带有圆形屋顶的原始铁皮电话亭于1926年首次出现。

ex.s: In the coming days, we 2___________ (paint) the iron roof of the toilet block that we had been building over the last two months.
ex.t: 在接下来的几天里，我们将给过去两个月来一直在修建的厕所的铁皮屋顶刷漆。

ex.s: People come from all over America to see skilled workers make wood, glass, and iron objects in the old-fashioned way.
ex.t: 人们从全美各地赶来，看熟练的工人用传统方式制作木头、玻璃和铁制品。

ex.s: Why was Lang Ping named "Iron Hammer"?
ex.t: 为什么郎平被称为铁榔头？

defs.def: a tool with a flat metal base that can be heated and used to make clothes smooth 熨斗
a tool made of iron or another metal 通常构成复合词

ex.s: Iron Hammer athletes.Shehasbeenavolleyball starformore than thirty-fiveyears and has contributed greatly to the sport, which has made her the most popular figure in China's volleyball history.
ex.t: 铁榔头运动员。她作为排球明星已经超过三十五年，为这项运动做出了巨大贡献，这使她成为中国排球史上最受欢迎的人物。

defs.def: chains or other heavy objects made of iron, attached to the arms and legs of prisoners, especially in the past （尤指旧时的）镣铐
one of the set of clubs (= sticks for hitting the ball with) that have a metal head 铁头球棒

ex.s: No one who was present could hold back the tears – even the captain and crew, who were all men of iron.
ex.t: 在场的人无不热泪盈眶——连船长和船员这些铁打的汉子也是如此。

defs.def: to remove the creases (= folds that you do not want) from clothes, etc. by using an iron 熨平（衣服等的）皱褶

ex.s: It might be the time when you helped a friend with their homework, when you did the ironing without being asked, or when you baked cookies after the family had had a tiring day. ____18____
ex.t: 可能是你帮朋友做功课的时候，可能是你主动熨衣服的时候，也可能是你在家人疲惫一天后烤饼干的时候。____18____

defs.def: to get rid of any problems or difficulties that are affecting sth 解决影响 … 的问题（或困难）

ex.s: Such wrinkles will no doubt be ironed out, yet they also point to a fundamental problem.
ex.t: 这些缺陷无疑会被解决，但它们也指向一个根本问题。
